[V4.3.2](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/en/0x12-V4-Access-Control.md#v43-other-access-control-considerations)

Current:
> V4.3.2 Verify that directory browsing is disabled unless deliberately desired. Additionally, applications should not allow discovery or disclosure of file or directory metadata, such as Thumbs.db, .DS_Store, .git or .svn folders. 

Problems:
- it contains 2 separate problems which requires separate defense methods
- if you disable directory browsing, mentioned files and folders are still readable
- if you disable reading mentioned files, it does not affect directory browsing

Proposal, split to 2 different requirements.

Milestone ASVS v4.1 (as it changes requirements numbers)

Proposal, split to 2 different requirements.

Second part of the requirement maybe should be merged with current V12.5.1?
> V12.5.1 Verify that the web tier is configured to serve only files with specific file extensions to prevent unintentional information and source code leakage. For example, backup files (e.g. .bak), temporary working files (e.g. .swp), compressed files (.zip, .tar.gz, etc) and other extensions commonly used by editors should be blocked unless required.

Current requirement:
* V4.3.2 Verify that directory browsing is disabled unless deliberately desired. Additionally, applications should not allow discovery or disclosure of file or directory metadata, such as Thumbs.db, .DS_Store, .git or .svn folders.

Split and move to category "V14.3 Configuration > Unintended Security Disclosure"

Proposal 1: `[ADDED, SPLIT FROM 4.3.2]`
* V14.3.4 Verify that directory browsing is disabled unless deliberately desired.
* [CWE-548](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/548.html)

Proposal 2: `[ADDED, SPLIT FROM 4.3.2]`
* V14.3.5 Verify that applications do not allow discovery or disclosure of file or directory metadata, such as Thumbs.db, .DS_Store, .git or .svn folders.
* CWE ? <- need help here. From different CWE's for .git (source code leakage) and Thumbs.db (some thumbnail leakage) we may want to split it again.

I'll make separate issue for mentioned V12.5.1 if this issue is finished.
